name: Annotations Overlay
description: Shows annotations as triggered inline help overlays on entity forms and view displays, with per-user annotation-type hiding.
project_description: Annotations Overlay surfaces annotation content as triggered <dialog> help overlays attached to individual fields on entity add/edit forms and on rendered view displays, plus bundle-level overviews on entity/node add-list chooser pages. Editors get in-context guidance exactly where they need it; each user can hide annotation types they do not want to see. Content is rendered server-side via the annotation view builder (view mode 'overlay') and escaped.
